messages:
lina: Heads-up: hitting a weird edge with embeddings routing when clients send tiny batches with high-dim vectors. Console shows a lot of tiny-split fallbacks and customers see unexpected unit usage. Anyone seen this pattern?

matt: yup saw it in prod traces this morning. small batches (1-3 vectors) where dim=2048 are getting split into 2 shards, runtime routes to fallback path. obs: increased per-request DB writes and splitter churn.

dave: concrete repro? sample header from ingested request?

lina: example request header we got from a customer: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
X-Embed-Dims: 2048
Content-Length: 34000
Body: ["...single long text..."]
```
The router preflight classifies by bytes-first and then dims; because Content-Length ~34KB we trigger splitter -> two shards. But the quota calc later counts both shards as full units, not as fractional, so cost spikes.

yara: ah, billing semantics mismatch again. Runtime treats shards as internal fragments but console/usage pipeline attributes them as separate embedding units. We need to align: either attribute fractional units based on dims or make splitter emit an attribution event.

matt: agree. Quick proposal: add a metric "embed.split_fragments_per_request" and emit the original request vector_count + total_fragments. Then console can divide billing by (fragments / original_count) or show an "internal fragments" column in the route details.

lina: +1. Also want a UX hint in the console for suggested client-side split thresholds. Like: "Your typical dims=2048 requests will be cheaper if batched >=4 or use dims-compact models" — show simulated unit cost delta.

dave: how would we compute the simulated delta? we need token of logic: current unit = ceil(shard_bytes / unit_bytes) * shard_count. suggestion: re-run splitter simulation offline with the last 7 days of samples and surface savings. But watch perf of running heavy sims in UI.

yara: alternative: compute conservatively using dims and byte heuristic without full sim: estimate_units = sum( max(1, ceil((dims * vector_count * bytes_per_value) / unit_bytes)) ). It's rough but cheap. We can label it "estimate".

lina: feels fine. Must also add telemetry: "embed.preflight_decision" with tags: dims, vector_count, route_variant, fallback=true/false, split_count. Then we can build SLOs for false-positive splits.

ingest-bot: deploy scheduled: splitter-metrics-exporter v2 -> staging at 7865432120.

matt: implementation details: runtime will emit two events: preflight.decide (original request id, dims, vectors, bytes, route) and splitter.emit (orig_id, fragment_id, fragment_bytes). Downstream usage pipeline should join on orig_id to avoid double-counting.

dave: joining on orig_id is sensible but we already stream usage events without orig_id in some legacy paths. Might need a mapper to backfill mapping or use a deterministic fragment id scheme: origid.fragmentidx.

yara: ops/console implications: new dashboard widgets: "split-rate (per route)", "avg fragments/request", and a per-customer estimated savings gauge. UX: add a toggle in tenant view "Show cost attribution by original request" vs "by fragment". Default to original request to avoid alarming customers.

lina: and a rollout plan: stage metrics export -> console chart preview for internal beta -> tenant opt-in -> global flip. Also docs update for billing semantics paragraph.

matt: one more gotcha: some clients rely on small batches for memory reasons (mobile). We should add a router policy: attenuate-priority for tiny-batches to prefer low-overhead path even if slightly slower, to avoid splits. configurable per-tenant.

dave: can we add a header hint for clients like `X-Embed-Prefer-No-Split: 1` so SDKs can opt-in? runtime then tries to coalesce or accept a near-threshold cost. Must be opt-in for billing clarity.

yara: +1 to header opt-in. Add to SDK changelog. And gate server-side by a feature flag first.

lina: action items: matt -> proto for telemetry events (due EOD). dave -> splitter attribution id and mapper (PR next week). yara -> console wire for estimate and toggle (mock by Thurs). I'll draft a short note for billing on the docs site.

matt: I'll include sample metrics names: `embed.preflight`, `embed.split_fragments`, `embed.fragment_bytes`, `embed.attribution_join_rate`.

lina: awesome. If we get anything weird after staging deploy ping #eng-oncall. Thanks all :thumbsup:

matt: :thumbsup:

ingest-bot: deployed splitte r-metrics-exporter v2 to staging at 7865432124 (run id f3a9)

lina: saw staging traces showing preflight events. initial split-rate on sample tenant dropped from 0.42 -> 0.07 with attenuate-priority enabled. promising.

yara: great. I'll schedule the console beta review for Monday.

dave: noted, will start the mapper PR tomorrow.
